rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error, finding (F1) and scope; i8949 p. 8, code B: "You received a Form 1099-B or Form 1099-DA (or substitute statement) and the basis shown in box 1e on Form 1099-B or box 1g on Form 1099-DA is incorrect"; f8949 p. 1, box G: "Short-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-DA showing basis was reported to the IRS"; i1040sd p. 11, line 18: "Collectibles include works of art, rugs, antiques, metals (such as gold, silver, and platinum bullion), gems, stamps, coins, alcoholic beverages, and certain other tangible property. Include on the worksheet any gain (but not loss) from the sale or exchange of an interest in a partnership, S corporation, or trust held for more than 1 year and attributable to unrealized appreciation of collectibles.". executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.json`; 1,382 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 630 partial records from 40 bases; 2,245 comparisons; every witness re-read from an uncapped scratch re-run of triage.mjs, same counts): 1,739 of 2,245 agree; 298 candidate-refuses (70 completed), 208 candidate-unknown (29 completed). (1) The reply adds boxes G and J to the reported-basis boxes, the source's reading; Boxes G and J (and H, I, K, L) are refused for the return by sales.digital at sales.one (checked: sales.refuse.digital.G and generated 8, 21, 92, 160, 256, 357, 470 refuse Form 1040 lines 7a and 16 on sales.digital), so the difference cannot reach a completed return. (2) The 70 completed candidate-refuses are the reply's own consistency check h_basis_uncoded (box A or D, code none or W, reported basis different from correct basis): on such an entry the project reads only the reported basis, and the interview never asks sales.correct_basis (checked on classm.s3.2 sales[s1], box D code none: withheld, the interview completes), so every witness supplies an answer the interview cannot ask (classm.s3.2, classm.f1040.6, classm.f5695.2, classm.u1250.2, classm.clcw26.2 and partials; generated 236, 287, 453). The source routes an incorrect reported basis through code B, which the interview asks; no tax reading is at stake. (3) The 29 completed candidate-unknown are partial records withholding sales.special (28) or sales.aggregate_eligible (1): Finding F1 (SCREEN-UNANSWERED-PASSES, `sales.findings.md`): with sales.special or sales.aggregate_eligible unanswered, sales.one is unknown, but sd.screen (sd.count < 0) evaluates false through the engine's Count lower-bound shortcut, so the return completes as if the screen were answered no; the candidate correctly needs the answer. Witnesses: partial(classm.f8889.1.deepseek -special), project Form 1040 line 16 $18,089.13 computed, candidate unknown; with special true the return refuses. (4) The candidate-refuses on refused returns (special, h_aggregate_bad, h_code_other) are gates the project also has at sales.one; the incomplete-return unknowns are partial records: scope. BUG-0231 widened only the sales.special question (shares of an exchange-traded fund or trust holding gold, silver, platinum or other metals), which matches i1040sd p. 11 ("metals" and an interest in a "trust ... attributable to unrealized appreciation of collectibles"); a wider reading of it can only refuse. Project stands on this line.

Ruling: model error, finding (F1) and scope; i8949 p. 8, code B: "You received a Form 1099-B or Form 1099-DA (or substitute statement) and the basis shown in box 1e on Form 1099-B or box 1g on Form 1099-DA is incorrect"; f8949 p. 1, box G: "Short-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-DA showing basis was reported to the IRS"; i8949 p. 10, code W: "You have a nondeductible loss from a wash sale ... enter the amount of the nondeductible loss as a positive number in column (g)"; i8949 p. 10: "If no part of the loss is a nondeductible loss from a wash sale transaction, enter -0- in column (g)." executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.json`; 1,382 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 630 partial records from 40 bases; 2,245 comparisons; every witness re-read from an uncapped scratch re-run of triage.mjs, same counts): 1,742 of 2,245 agree; 361 candidate-refuses (87 completed), 142 candidate-unknown (29 completed). (1) Boxes G and J take the code B correction in the reply; Boxes G and J (and H, I, K, L) are refused for the return by sales.digital at sales.one (checked: sales.refuse.digital.G and generated 8, 21, 92, 160, 256, 357, 470 refuse Form 1040 lines 7a and 16 on sales.digital). (2) 70 completed candidate-refuses are h_basis_uncoded, as on column (e): the correct basis is an answer the interview does not ask on a box A or D entry without code B. (3) 17 completed candidate-refuses are h_wash_excess, a limit the reply's own note says the instructions "do not state": classm.s3.2 sales[s3] (box C, code W, proceeds $55,549, basis $20,475, a gain, wash loss $449: project (g) $449.00) and its twin and partials, and generated 20, 73, 226, 346, 429, 433. The source names no such refusal; a wash-sale loss entered on a gain sale is an inconsistent record (observation O1 in `sales.findings.md`), not a tax reading. (4) The 29 completed candidate-unknown are the F1 partials (special 28, aggregate_eligible 1). Finding F1 (SCREEN-UNANSWERED-PASSES, `sales.findings.md`): with sales.special or sales.aggregate_eligible unanswered, sales.one is unknown, but sd.screen (sd.count < 0) evaluates false through the engine's Count lower-bound shortcut, so the return completes as if the screen were answered no; the candidate correctly needs the answer. Witnesses: partial(classm.f8889.1.deepseek -special), project Form 1040 line 16 $18,089.13 computed, candidate unknown; with special true the return refuses. (5) The other candidate-refuses (h_wash_uncoded, special, h_aggregate_bad, h_code_other) are on refused or incomplete returns: scope. BUG-0231 widened only the sales.special question (shares of an exchange-traded fund or trust holding gold, silver, platinum or other metals), which matches i1040sd p. 11 ("metals" and an interest in a "trust ... attributable to unrealized appreciation of collectibles"); a wider reading of it can only refuse. Project stands on this line.
